description.title: חומרים מהותיים
description.summary: This table lists 'material matters' that must be disclosed when applying for car insurance. It details information about the vehicle, its use, the driver, and past incidents.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת 'חומרים מהותיים' שיש לדווח עליהם בעת הגשת בקשה לביטוח רכב. המידע כולל פרטים על סוג הרכב, שנת ייצור, מספר רישוי, יצרן ודגם, סוג תיבת ההילוכים, פטור ממס על הרכב, תיאור השימוש ברכב והמקום בו הוא שמור בדרך כלל. כמו כן, נדרשים פרטים על בעלי הרכב או מחזיקים קבועים, תאונות בהן היו מעורבים ועבירות תנועה בהן הורשעו בשלוש השנים האחרונות. ביטוח רכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון יוני 2023 באנגלית מציג את החומרים הללו. סוג הרכב, שנת ייצור, מספר רישוי, יצרן ודגם, תיבת הילוכים, פטור ממס, תיאור שימוש, מקום אחסון, זהות הבעלים, תאונות קודמות, עבירות תנועה, נזקים קודמים, פרטי מבוטחים קודמים.

38.2 A material matter is a matter regarding which a question was posed in the insurance proposal or in any other manner, which shall be documented by the insurer, and without derogating from the generality of the aforementioned, also the following:
38.2.1 Type of vehicle, year of manufacture, license number, make and model, type of gearbox.
38.2.2 Exemption from tax on the vehicle, if any.
38.2.3 Description of the vehicle's use and of the place where it is generally kept.
38.2.4 The vehicle protective means
38.2.5 Identity of the vehicle's owners or regular holders and their occupations; accidents in which they were involved and traffic offenses of which they were convicted during the three years preceding arrangement of the insurance under this policy, excluding traffic offenses for which a fine is optional.
38.2.6 Damage sustained by the vehicle or a third party during the last three years, occurring as a result of the risks included in this insurance, except during a period when the vehicle was not owned by the insured, for which a claim was filed -as defined in paragraph 52.3.
38.2.7 Details regarding previous insurers which insured the vehicle.

38.2.2 Exemption from tax on the vehicle, if any.
38.2.3 Description of the vehicle's use and of the place where it is generally kept.
38.2.4 The vehicle protective means
38.2.5 Identity of the vehicle's owners or regular holders and their occupations; accidents in which they were involved and traffic offenses of which they were convicted during the three years preceding arrangement of the insurance under this policy, excluding traffic offenses for which a fine is optional.
38.2.6 Damage sustained by the vehicle or a third party during the last three years, occurring as a result of the risks included in this insurance, except during a period when the vehicle was not owned by the insured, for which a claim was filed -as defined in paragraph 52.3.
38.2.7 Details regarding previous insurers which insured the vehicle.
